notes: Official API model ID sam-3.1 (Segment Anything Model 3.1) on Meta Model API through the Responses API: text prompt, image or video in, boxes and pixel masks out. Billed per image ($2.50 per 1,000) and per video frame ($0.20 per 1,000, at least 50 frames per video request), not per token. Null V1 token fields mean not applicable, not free. Availability varies by country under Meta's Geographic Use Policy. Meta does not publish a release date.

price_records.billing_note: Image segmentation at $2.50 per 1,000 images on Meta Model API. Video segmentation costs $0.20 per 1,000 frames, with each video request billed for at least 50 frames (usage.video_frames_processed reports the frames billed); the dataset has no per-frame unit, so the video rate is kept in this note. Streaming and non-streaming requests cost the same.
